questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

The middle writing instrument points downwards with a tip, while the left and right instruments have caps at the bottom, indicating they are not all aligned identically.
The middle instrument appears to be a pencil or a different type of pen (thinner, no cap), differing in appearance from the two identical capped pens on the sides.
The middle instrument shows a bare writing tip (or pencil lead) at the bottom, whereas the other two are fully capped.
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The writing instruments remain fixed in their positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The middle item is visually distinct (likely a pencil or uncapped pen) showing a bare tip, while the other two are identical capped pens. This violates the conditions for identical color, orientation, and capping.
